_note: Read 17 Sep 2026. The project page slug is 'citywalk-central-park', not 'central-park-city-walk' (that URL 404s). The page is organised by phase (Plaza, Thyme, Erin, Fern, Laurel, Castleton, Myrtle), each with a three-image header set and a construction gallery; the first header of each phase and two sample construction frames are registered. One further asset, 'City Walk Central Park Video BG.jpg', is published at 706x581 and was left out because its short side is under the 600px floor. Meraas gates the brochure, floor-plan pack, payment plan and masterplan download behind a 'Register Your Interest' form asking for name, email, phone and country. That form was NOT submitted and nothing behind it was fetched; only images published openly on the page are listed. meraas.com returns HTTP 403 to a browser user-agent, so the page was read via WebFetch and every URL below was then confirmed to return HTTP 200 before being registered.
